name: DESERT PATROL CLASH
situation_report: Reconnaissance patrols from both sides have unexpectedly encountered each other in the desert. Neither side has had time to prepare positions. The side that can seize the key terrain features and establish control will gain valuable intelligence and tactical advantage.
tactical_context: This is a fast-moving encounter battle. Scout units are critical for gaining initiative and choosing favorable positions. Rapid deployment and aggressive movement to objectives will determine the victor.

terrain_features.name: Stream/Irrigation Ditch
terrain_features.special_rules: Difficult terrain for vehicles. May have vegetation along banks (soft cover).

terrain_features.name: Stone Building
terrain_features.description: Small stone structure, typical Arab architecture.
terrain_features.special_rules: Infantry gain hard cover. Impassable to vehicles unless destroyed.

terrain_features.name: Oasis
terrain_features.description: Small oasis with palm trees and water. Strategic objective.
terrain_features.special_rules: Counts as wood for cover (soft). Usually marks an objective. May include a well.

terrain_notes: Light terrain typical of desert patrol routes

effects: Desert Dust Cloud begins on turn 6
From turn 6: Maximum artillery spotter range 40"

victory_conditions:
**Major Victory**: Control 3+ objectives at game end AND have not reached BR limit.

**Minor Victory**: Control 2+ objectives at game end OR force enemy to BR limit.

**Draw**: Equal objectives controlled or both sides reach BR limit.
deployment_steps: Both players count their scout/recce units
Player with MOST scouts chooses table edge (tie = roll off)
Player with MOST scouts deploys first
Both players place scouts first, then remaining units alternately
Roll for initiative each turn (scouts give +1 per scout unit)

special_rules: May deploy scouts up to 18" onto table
May deploy scouts up to 18" onto table

objectives.spacing_rules: All objectives must be 10" from table edges and other objectives

special_rules: **Scout Advantage**: +1 to initiative per scout unit
**Ambush Fire**: Side with most scouts may have D3 units ambush fire
**Mobile Warfare**: All vehicles move at full speed on roads/tracks
**Meeting Engagement**: No prepared positions or fortifications
